entries.title: Minecraft Vitest Mocks
entries.snippet: minecraft-vitest-mocks A template library for mocking the Minecraft Bedrock Script API modules with Vitest. This is not designed to be exhaustive, but rather will be updated with whatever mocks I need for my own testing. If you want to contribute, please open a pull request with your changes. To use the mocks, simply use them…

entries.title: Dynamic Property Management
entries.snippet: Dynamic property management import { worldDynamicPropertyStore } from '@forestoflight/minecraft-vitest-mocks' worldDynamicPropertyStore.set('key', { myProperty: 5 }); const value = worldDynamicPropertyStore.get('key'); // value is Stringified JSON: "{ myProperty: 5 }" ... or you can use the dynamicProperties property directly…

entries.title: Scheduler
entries.snippet: Scheduler This class handles callbacks passed to system.run and other, similar methods. To step through ticks: import { scheduler } from '@forestoflight/minecraft-vitest-mocks' scheduler.advanceTicks(5); To reset all scheduled tasks: import { scheduler } from '@forestoflight/minecraft-vitest-mocks' scheduler.reset();
